provenance.selection_rule: median final H among adaptive_causal conjunctive successes
provenance.selection_note: Part L's declared rule, applied in run_release_clarity.py and copied here verbatim. 3 episode(s) were eligible. The episode is not re-chosen by this exporter.
provenance.caveat: Illustration only. Not used for any aggregate claim.
provenance.replay_note: Per-timestep headings were not persisted by the science runs (run_closed_loop.py drops z_hist explicitly). They are regenerated here by a deterministic replay of the frozen simulator at the same seed, the same regime and the recorded action sequence, and every replayed quantity is asserted equal to the frozen file: the qualifying start I0, H*(I_t) at all 24 control steps, the final state and lineage, the structural interface size at every step, and all 16 release records including the H trace. No new statistic is computed and no result file is modified.
provenance.detector_note: The emergence pass runs the frozen blind detector at each timestep from t = 8 (its affinity window) to t = 60. The science only ran it at t0; the earlier steps are shown as detector output, not as a Stage 6.10 result. The t0 entry is asserted equal to the episode's frozen I0.

phases.label: Unstructured
phases.note: Before the detector's affinity window is filled, nothing is proposed.

phases.label: Emergence
phases.note: Coherent domains form; the blind detector proposes candidates each step.

phases.label: Detected thing
phases.note: The qualifying start I0 -- moderate size, single component, most clump-like. Morphology only: no target heading and no control outcome enter this choice.

phases.label: Adaptive steering
phases.note: Control on. The interior and the interface are both re-inferred online.

phases.label: Release
phases.note: Control off for the remaining steps.

task.selected_by: full-model control benchmark only; no inference arm was run on any cell before this decision
